title: PipelessPipes
description: A simple pipesystem without the hassle of laying pipes
body:
## PipelessPipes  
**A simple but powerful item transportation system for your server.**

Are you tired of laying endless meters of pipes? Then this is the solution for you!
PipelessPipes is a lightweight plugin that lets you connect containers directly and transfer items from one to another. It supports filtering of items with a whitelist or blacklist to make item management easier and faster. Also you can add an unlimited number of items to your filter.

---

💡 **Features**
- 🚀 Instant container-to-container item transfer
- ⚙️ Customizable filters
- ✅ Whitelists & ❌ Blacklists for easy control
- ⚡ Quick and simple setup
- ✒️ No long commands required
- 🌍 Supports English and German (players can choose their own language)
- 📝 Fully customizable: pipewrench texture, messages, and GUI text

---

❓ **How to use**

1. First, you need a **Pipewrench**. Get one with: `/pipe givePipeTool`
2. Click on any container (e.g., chest, double chest, barrel, furnace, dispenser, dropper, etc.).
3. (Optional) If you or a player want to change the displayed language (only for themselves) they can do that with `/pipe setLanguage <deutsch|englisch>`

### Define container
![Image that shows the pipe defining gui](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d56bd6cae937a6f775084ddfdd73f5864f8f2c3b.png)

After clicking, a GUI will open with two options:
- **Define as Input**
- **Define as Output** 

### Input Pipe
![Image that shows the input settings GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/712f61cedb201f637e88c23e5474315c04ea9d09.png)

If you set a container as *Input*, the GUI lets you:
- Change it to an Output node
- Remove it from the network

### Output Pipe
![Image that shows the output settings GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/64b06a9c1dbf2f8d3661ca8daf3e77047d250cc0.png)

If you set a container as *Output*, the GUI lets you:
- Change it to an Input node
- Remove it from the network
- **Manage filters**

### Filters
![Image that shows the filter settings GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dff5c1ad7e4947ba40cfd93e140358ad26e932bf.png)

When you open the filter GUI, you’ll see:
 - **White-/Black Dye** → Switch between whitelist (default) and blacklist
 - **Barrier / Item in offhand** → Add the item in your offhand to the filter
 - **Chest minecart** → Add all items from the container to the filter
 - **Book** → Add items manually via chat command: `/pipe addFilterItem [Item]` (Replace [Item] with the actual item)
 - **Red Wool** → Reset the filter  
 - **Ender Eye** → View the full filter. There you can click on an item to remove it from the filter.
![Image that shows a big filter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b7023c16cff3f6994e803b3ab9ef9a67bf039f9e.png) ![Image that shows a small filter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d6cc6989e04748d2dfbf08df86154c0220ebf77f.png)

---

📄 **Permissions**

| Permission                          | Default       | Description                                |
|-------------------------------------|---------------|--------------------------------------------|
| `pipelesspipes.command.pipe`        | true          | Use the `/pipe` command                    |
| `pipelesspipes.command.language`    | true          | Set the displayed language                  |
| `pipelesspipes.command.pipe.addFilterItem` | true   | Add a filter item via command              |
| `pipelesspipes.command.pipe.admin`  | false (op)    | Get a Pipewrench                           |
